jobs.title: LPG Analyst
jobs.description:
As an LPG Analyst to support our global oil trading team, providing in-depth market analysis, building and updating supply and demand models, providing value-add market insights, and analyzing high-frequency indicators of market dynamics. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland.

Key Responsibilities

• Collating, analysing and interpreting data to produce commodity market insights

• Conduct comprehensive research and analysis on fuel oil markets, including supply/demand dynamics, pricing trends, arbitrage opportunities, and regulatory developments across major global trading hubs

• Build and maintaining supply and demand models, and develop detailed market reports, presentations, and trade recommendations to inform trading strategies

• Provide trade flow analysis and other ad-hoc analysis to support decision-making by senior traders and management

• Collaborate closely with traders, operations teams, and other analysts to identify trading opportunities, monitor positions, and manage risk exposure

• Build and maintain proprietary models and tools for market analysis, forecasting, and scenario planning.

• Stay up-to-date on industry news, market intelligence, and competitor activities to provide a competitive edge

• Establish strong relationships with key market participants, including refiners, suppliers, and customers, to gather market intelligence.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related quantitative field;

• Minimum of 4 years of experience in commodity analysis or a related analytical role, preferably with exposure to fuel oil/refined products markets

• Prior experience in commodity research, specifically in LPG analytics

• Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data sets and extract meaningful insights

• Experience using trade data, data visualization tools and statistical data modeling software.

• Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Python, R, SQL) and Microsoft Office suite.

• Knowledge of commodity trading fundamentals, risk management principles, and financial modeling

• Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced educational degree

• Fluency in another foreign language

• Programming experience and a solid understanding of database concepts (Python and SQL preferred; R, MATLAB or VBA beneficial).

• Direct knowledge of LPG markets

Attributes for success

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely

• Strong intrinsic interest in financial markets, geopolitical developments and a sound understanding of economic theory and cycles

• Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Ability to work independently and proactively to deliver timely results.

• Analytical mindset and critical thinking skills, with an emphasis on providing proactive insights that have tradeable value.

Work Authorization:

We welcome applications from candidates across the globe. Relocation support and visa sponsorship details will be discussed during the hiring process.

Reporting Structure
- Reporting directly to Head of Oil Research Europe & Asia

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse workforce! We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or handicap, disability, or any other legally protected status.

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des risques du marché – Produits pétroliers

jobs.description:
Main purpose

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Market Risk Manager for Oil Products. The ideal candidate will have at least 10 years of relevant experience as a trader or risk manager specializing in the trading of physical oil products at a reputable physical commodities trading house. This role requires an in-depth understanding of physical oil markets, pricing mechanisms, logistics, quality and blending, regulations, market dynamics, contractual terms, and market participants. The successful candidate will be responsible for aggregating Trafigura's exposure, identifying concentrated risks, and reporting these to the Head of Market Risk. Additionally, the role involves collaborating with front office teams, senior management, and contributing to the development of risk management systems.

This role will report to Head of Market Risk Physical Oil Products and will sit with the broader Market Risk team in Geneva to facilitate interaction with global trading desks and IT teams which support the Market Risk Management organization.

Key responsibilities

• Risk Aggregation & Reporting:

• Aggregate and analyze Trafigura’s exposure across physical oil products in a meaningful way.

• Identify and highlight categories of concentrated risk, reporting findings to the Head of Market Risk.

• Set up risk limits and monitor their usage, ensuring alignment with Trafigura’s risk appetite.

• Market Risk Analysis:

• Design and implement risk scenarios including historical analysis, ad hoc scenarios, and stress tests.

• Ensure accuracy in Value at Risk (VaR) calculations and provide detailed P&L breakdowns and explanations.

• Perform continuous monitoring and assessment of market dynamics, pricing mechanisms, and trading strategies.

• Collaboration & Communication:

• Maintain strong interactions with the front office, providing risk insights and ensuring alignment on risk management strategies.

• Liaise with senior management to communicate risk positions, potential exposures, and strategic recommendations.

• Work closely with the IT and systems teams to enhance risk management tools, ensuring they meet the evolving needs of the market.

• Risk Management Systems Development:

• Contribute to the development and refinement of risk management systems, ensuring robust data integration and analytical capabilities.

• Utilize SQL, Python, and AI to navigate and enhance the existing risk management landscape.

• Ensure systems are capable of providing accurate, real-time data for decision-making and reporting purposes.

• Regulatory Compliance & Risk Governance:

• Stay informed on global regulations affecting the oil market, including environmental policies, sanctions, and trade restrictions.

• Ensure compliance with all relevant regulatory requirements and internal policies. Lead all aspects of the establishment and maintenance of strong contractual risk management processes.

Required qualifications

• Minimum of 10 years of experience as a trader or risk manager in physical oil products at a reputable physical commodities trading house.

• Deep knowledge of physical oil markets, including types of oil products, pricing mechanisms, logistics, quality, blending, and market dynamics.

• Strong understanding of contractual terms, credit risk, and the upstream and downstream oil market participants.

• Proven experience in aggregating exposure, managing concentrated risks, and reporting to senior management.

• Proficiency in SQL and Python, and other relevant tools for risk management and system development.

• Good knowledge of financial derivatives is a must-have.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with front office teams and senior management.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to design and implement complex risk scenarios and stress tests.

• Highly motivated with a collaborative mindset and a keen appetite for system enhancement and risk management innovation.

• Esperienza comprovata nell'aggregazione dell'esposizione, nella gestione dei rischi concentrati e nel reporting alla gestione senior.
• Proficienza in SQL e Python, e altri strumenti rilevanti per la gestione del rischio e lo sviluppo del sistema.
• La buona conoscenza dei derivati finanziari è un must-have.

Ce rôle exige une compréhension approfondie des marchés pétroliers physiques, des mécanismes de tarification, de la logistique, de la qualité et du mélange, de la réglementation, de la dynamique du marché, des conditions contractuelles et des participants au marché. Le candidat retenu sera chargé d'agréger l'exposition de Trafigura, d'identifier les risques concentrés et de les signaler au responsable du risque de marché. De plus, le rôle consiste à collaborer avec les équipes de direction, la haute direction et à contribuer à l'élaboration de systèmes de gestion des risques. Ce rôle relèvera du chef des produits pétroliers physiques à risque de marché et siégera avec l'équipe plus large de risque de marché à Genève afin de faciliter l'interaction avec les comptoirs commerciaux mondiaux et les équipes informatiques qui appuient l'organisation de gestion des risques de marché. • Agrégation et déclaration des risques :
• Agréger et analyser l'exposition de Trafigura à travers les produits pétroliers physiques de manière significative.
• Identifier et mettre en évidence les catégories de risque concentré, en rendant compte des résultats au chef du risque de marché.
• Mettre en place des limites de risque et surveiller leur utilisation, en assurant l'alignement avec Trafigura.

• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des scénarios de risque comprenant des analyses historiques, des scénarios ponctuels et des tests de résistance.
• Assurer l'exactitude des calculs de la valeur à risque (VaR) et fournir des ventilations et des explications détaillées sur la valeur à risque.
• Effectuer un suivi et une évaluation continus de la dynamique du marché, des mécanismes de tarification et des stratégies commerciales.

• Maintenir de solides interactions avec le front office, fournir des renseignements sur les risques et assurer l'harmonisation des stratégies de gestion des risques.
• Assurer la liaison avec la haute direction pour communiquer les positions de risque, les expositions potentielles et les recommandations stratégiques.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes TI et systèmes pour améliorer les outils de gestion des risques, en s'assurant qu'ils répondent aux besoins changeants du marché.

• Contribuer à l'élaboration et au perfectionnement des systèmes de gestion des risques, en assurant une solide intégration des données et des capacités d'analyse.
• Utiliser SQL, Python et AI pour naviguer et améliorer le paysage de gestion des risques existant.

jobs.title: CTRM Business Architect
jobs.description:
Main purpose
We are seeking a hands-on business architect to lead the front to back functional architecture for our Metals, Minerals & Bulk CTRM system. You will be transforming complex, cross-department business initiatives into architectural roadmaps, ensuring alignment of IT solutions with business objectives in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Key responsibilities

• Transform business objectives into a functional architecture view that aligns IT and business teams

• Lead strategic architectural decisions, including buy vs. build recommendations

• Create actionable roadmaps balancing long-term vision with immediate needs

• Proficient in managing cross functional complexity and facilitating complex trade-off decisions, such as balancing global process standards with local market needs

• Support application teams throughout delivery, managing architectural alignment and accommodating change

• Guide the evolution of Trafigura’s functional landscape and conceptual data models

• Partner with technical leads to ensure our technical architecture supports business goals

• Keep up with industry trends to drive innovation and process improvements

• Lead and develop a team of architects, balancing their personal growth with business goals

• Foster a culture of collaboration and excellence across the IT organisation

Required qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in a business analyst and/or architect role

• 3+ years of experience managing and developing people within a fast-paced, high-performance environment

• Strong domain knowledge in commodity trading covering the end to end physical trade lifecycle

• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, frameworks, and modern practices like modular architecture and API-led integration

• Proven success delivering large-scale applications in global teams

• The ability to translate business goals into actionable technical plans, resolve complex conflicts, and make decisions that balance short-term needs with long-term vision

• Ability to plan and execute work independently with a proactive approach

• Comfortable working in a flat, matrix management structure

• Fluent in English

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with a range of CTRM systems

Attributes for success

• Delivery focus with a can-do attitude

• Clear and engaging communicator

• Ability to take ownership of decisions in a fast-paced environment

• Collaborative and inclusive mindset

Department overview
Trafigura is committed to building and maintaining world class IT applications and infrastructure. The Trading IT group directly supports the Trafigura trading business, and this business has started a far-reaching programme to enhance and improve its trading applications using an innovative architecture to support business growth across the full range of business lines and geographies, and to enable the sharing of systems across different businesses.
This programme is aimed at delivering functional capabilities, enhancements and technical infrastructure upgrades to enable continued business growth and enhanced profitability for the firm.

Global Head of M&M and Bulk Technology

Trading IT organisation – Product managers, delivery leads, business analysts, functional architects, technical architects, developers, QA and project managers.

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Main Purpose

The Compliance department at Trafigura is a global function responsible for ensuring the business operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies. The team provides guidance and oversight across the Group's trading, operations, and corporate functions — covering areas including anti-bribery and corruption (ABC), sanctions screening, anti-money laundering (AML), trade controls, and regulatory compliance. Working closely with Legal, Finance, and the business lines, Compliance plays a critical role in managing regulatory risk, maintaining Trafigura's licence to operate, and embedding a strong culture of integrity across the organisation.

The Senior Compliance manager will assist the Chief Compliance Officer with all aspects of assessing, monitoring and developing the Trafigura Group Compliance Program to ensure the consistent and robust continuous improvement of the Compliance program.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Compliance or law professional with at least 10 years’ relevant experience

• Hands-on experience with sanctions programmes, screenings and interpretation of applicable trade controls

• Experience in commodities trading and commodity shipping, ideally with significant international and cross border experience

• Should have extensive experience of all aspects of a corporate compliance program including anti-bribery and corruption, anti-money laundering, trade sanctions, and market abuse.

• Working knowledge of European regulatory frameworks, particularly Swiss law, EU, UK, US, Swiss sanctions regimes, and EMIR/MiFID II

• AML/KYC operational experience in a financial services or trading environment

• Good IT skills and organisational skills

• Strong project management skills

• Excellent command of written and spoken English

• Experience with Relativity desired

Key Responsibilities

• Review complex sanctions-related queries and regulatory updates. This involves interpreting applicable sanctions regimes, assessing their relevance to business activities, ensuring trade compliance, and drafting or updating sanctions guidance and policies accordingly.

• Review escalations related to gifts and entertainment

• Review complex third party payment issues

• Investigating possible breaches of the Code of Business Conduct or other Compliance policies and implementing any required rectification

• Providing the escalation point for complex / non-standard KYC / AML issues

• Implementation of Compliance Projects related to Artificial Intelligence

• To keep all existing training up to date and develop new training where necessary.

• Co-ordinate and progress a variety of process / system / policy review and improvement projects.

• Assist with internal compliance investigation and review

• Coordinate and assist compliance with internal and external audit

• Coordinate and assist with the compliance global annual risk review

• Build relationships with key relationships departments outlined below

• Legal

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Credit Portfolio Management
jobs.description:
Main purpose

• Work at the intersection of credit, trade finance, operations, structured finance and technology.

• Perform portfolio analytics covering standard MI & reporting to advance analytics on MTM calculation, stress testing and sensitivity analysis.

• Act as functional owner and manage stakeholders for the inhouse credit risk system used across the organization with functions such as exposure calculation, limit monitoring, reporting and other related functions.

Key responsibilities

• Translate business requirements into a prioritised system roadmap, working closely with IT, developers and the wider credit team.

• Manage the credit risk data model, integrating data from relevant source systems, cleaning and transforming and integrating into a reporting tool.

• Enhance credit risk reporting functionality including a flexible and powerful reporting tool.

• Credit modeling includes integration of financial, transaction and non-traditional data to highlight early warnings

• Credit portfolio management, including assessment and management of concentration risks.

• Development of methodology and implementation for credit modeling including EPE, PFE, stress testing and sensitivity analysis.

Required qualifications

• Minimum ~8-10 years’ experience in Credit risk analysis and data.

• Deep understanding and experience of sourcing high volume data for credit risk management across multiple systems and processes.

• Deep understanding of data visualization and risk reporting in credit risk management.

• Strong experience of credit risk modeling, including sensitivity analysis and stress testing.

• Experience of commodities trade flows and associated credit risk would be advantageous.

• SQL / Python expertise.

Preferred qualifications

• Master’s degree in finance, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics or a related quantitative discipline.

• CFA, FRM, PRM or equivalent credentials are preferred.

• Additional experience in programming and managing credit system.

Attributes for success

• Combination of expertise in Credit Risk, Commercial, and technology.

jobs.title: Head of IT Treasury
jobs.description:
Main Purpose
Trafigura is recruiting the IT counterpart to the Global Head of Treasury Technology: the technology delivery owner for the Group Treasury transformation, sitting in Finance & Corporate Technology. The two roles operate as a two-in-a-box — the business-side Head owns the roadmap, requirements, adoption and value; this role owns technical delivery, integration and platform health.
Scope spans Kyriba as the group treasury management and payment hub platform, the integration layer feeding it from the ERP, trading and back-office estate, the reconciliation around it, emerging settlement rails including digital assets, and the AI-assisted automation being built across all of it. The programme is partner-led: the vendor owns the engine and bank connectivity and the implementation partner configures, while IT owns the upstream integration, the data flows, security enablement and testing.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership

• Own the IT delivery plan — priorities, sequencing, budget and resourcing — defend ring-fenced capacity where competing programmes hold priority, and build the delivery, business analysis and architecture capability behind it

• Close the integration design: one baselined target design across the upstream estate before go-live, delivered incrementally, with decisions recorded and held

Treasury Technology Infrastructure

• Own the upstream integration layer and middleware as a product — build, observability and dual-routing while legacy and target run in parallel — and lead system integration testing, keeping QA distinct from business UAT with regression against ERP patch cycles

• Own reference and static data integration into Kyriba — sync model, mastering and stale copies; in practice the gate on payment testing

• Deliver AI-assisted automation across the estate — receipt matching and same-day cash application, intraday reconciliation, decision support — sourced from core systems, not report extracts

Global Payments Technology

• Deliver Kyriba payment hub integration end to end — payment initiation, status returns and bank statements — on ISO 20022 (pain and camt) with MT-to-MX migration, managing bank onboarding as a delivery dependency: corporate BIC, bank specifications, test environments and format variance

• Integrate emerging settlement rails, including a digital-asset custody platform: address and network validation in static data, holdings statements into reconciliation, non-ISO asset representation

• Carry the reconciliation estate through the statement-format migration, and decommission the legacy payment platforms

Governance & Compliance

• Own payment signing and key architecture with the CISO, including digital-asset custody controls, and the network perimeter

• Own the post-go-live run and support model: monitoring, incident ownership and remediation across platforms IT does not host

• Set and enforce the path to production for AI-assisted and business-built treasury applications — functional specification, test coverage, security remediation, observability and a named support model

Stakeholder Management

• Operate as the IT half of the two-in-a-box, with the standing to hold a position with senior sponsors and manage dependencies outside your line

• Manage vendors and partners on technical assurance and commercial control — proof in a working configuration, and renewal or exit decisions ahead of notice dates

Required qualifications:

Education & Experience

• Degree in Finance, Computer Science or Information Technology, with 10+ years in treasury, payments and financial technology leading multi-workstream transformation in a multi-vendor environment

• Delivery of a TMS or payment hub through vendor and implementation partners, and experience managing global teams and banking relationships

Technical Knowledge

• Treasury and payments depth — payment lifecycles, cash and liquidity, bank connectivity, reconciliation and matching, FX and interest-rate risk

Main purpose
This role supports Trafigura's Refined Metals trading desks. The Business Developer will originate and grow commercial opportunities across Turkey and the surrounding region, acting as the primary bridge between local counterparties and the Geneva trading desks.

jobs.title: Senior Investigations Officer
jobs.description:
Main Purpose
The Senior Investigations Officer will report to the Global Head of Investigations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in forensic accounting, investigations, and risk management. The successful individual will work closely with a wide range of departments to identify and investigate Code of Conduct non-compliance and serious misconduct related risks in order to ensure the integrity and security of the organization’s operations. The investigations officer will also work closely with the Operational Risk and Internal Controls team (“ORIC”) to remediate investigation findings and strengthen the control environment.

The remit of the role will include, but not be limited to:

• Driving excellence - Supporting the Head of Investigations in driving forward an internal investigations team that seeks continued respect and trust from the business, and that is renowned for its professional, timely, proportionate and independent work.

• Investigation leadership - The oversight and management of substantial / reputationally significant internal investigations across the global business.

• Leadership - Acting as technical Subject Matter Expert and line manager to the existing Investigations Officers

• Cross-function collaboration and coordination - Supporting the Head of Investigations / ORIC to create a more connected and collaborative wider team whose combined remit is the design and testing of Internal controls, providing support to the business to strengthen the process and control environment, and to investigate and remediate control, policy and code of conduct breaches.

• Methodology development - Supporting in the creation and roll-out of robust and consistent investigation and review methodologies, tools and deliverables across the Group.

• Upskilling in the field of investigations - Developing and providing technical training across the business.

• Governance support - Providing ad hoc input on initiatives owned by the Risk and Compliance teams that intersect with Fraud / investigations.

• Issue remediation and anti-fraud framework development - Working with Internal Controls to develop enhanced, dedicated, controls to prevent and detect internal and external fraud; and working with Internal Audit to help establish audit prioritisation based upon the outcome and learnings from investigations.

Key responsibilities

• To support the Trafigura Global Head of Investigations in addressing the main objectives of the Investigation team (and potentially also across Operational Risk and Internal Control), now and into the future as the objectives and priorities evolve.

• Under the direction of the Head of Investigations, lead / conduct complex investigations into suspected cases of internal and / or external fraud, financial misconduct, policy non-compliance and other serious cases of misconduct in the context of the Code of Conduct.

• Interview witnesses and investigation subjects; gather statements, and document findings comprehensively.

• Prepare/draft detailed investigative reports, including findings, conclusions, and recommendations for review by senior stakeholders within the business. Present investigation results to compliance, senior management and legal counsel as required.

• Maintain thorough and accurate records of all investigations and related activities.

• Support the Head of Investigations and ORIC in prioritizing team resource, in supervising ongoing activity and in preparing for reporting required at Board sub-committees and the quarterly Governance and Controls Steering Committee.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of a risk-based country / market review strategy with supporting investigation plans.

• Contribute to the design and implementation of anti-fraud strategies, policies, and procedures. Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend control improvements.

• Utilize data analytics and forensic tools to detect anomalies and potential fraud indicators.

• Under the direction of the Head of Investigations, lead / conduct complex investigations into suspected cases of internal and / or external fraud, financial misconduct, policy non-compliance and other serious cases of misconduct in the context of the Code of Conduct.

• Interview witnesses and investigation subjects; gather statements, and document findings comprehensively.

• Prepare/draft detailed investigative reports, including findings, conclusions, and recommendations for review by senior stakeholders within the business. Present investigation results to compliance, senior management and legal counsel as required.

• Maintain thorough and accurate records of all investigations and related activities.

• Support the Head of Investigations and ORIC in prioritizing team resource, in supervising ongoing activity and in preparing for reporting required at Board sub-committees and the quarterly Governance and Controls Steering Committee.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of a risk-based country / market review strategy with supporting investigation plans.

• Contribute to the design and implementation of anti-fraud strategies, policies, and procedures. Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend control improvements.

• Utilize data analytics and forensic tools to detect anomalies and potential fraud indicators.
